profiles.search_description: Create separate profiles with their own history, logins and settings, and open them in their own windows.
profiles.intro: Each profile keeps its own history, favorites, cookies, logins, password vault and settings. A profile opens in its own window, and you can have several open at once.
profiles.new_description: Up to {max} profiles. A new profile starts empty.
profiles.delete_warning: This permanently erases its history, favorites, cookies, logins, passwords and settings from this computer. It cannot be undone.
profiles.delete_type: Type the profile name to confirm
profiles.opened: The profile is opening in a new window.
profiles.updates_note: Spark updates are installed by the Default profile.
profiles.error_invalid_name: The name must have 1 to 40 characters, without line breaks or control characters.
profiles.error_duplicate: Another profile already has that name.
profiles.error_limit: The limit of profiles was reached. Delete one to create another.
profiles.error_in_use: That profile is open in another window. Close it first.
profiles.error_cannot_delete_current: You cannot delete the profile you are using. Open another profile and delete it from there.
profiles.error_cannot_delete_default: The Default profile cannot be deleted.
profiles.error_cannot_rename_default: The Default profile cannot be renamed.
profiles.error_private: Profiles are not available in private windows.
profiles.error_failed: Something went wrong with the profiles. The error log has the details.
profiles.picker_hint: Each profile has its own history, favorites, logins and settings.
profiles.error_open_failed: The profile could not be started. The error log has the details.
profiles.startup_label: Ask which profile to open when Spark starts
profiles.startup_description: Show a window to choose the profile every time Spark starts. When off, Spark opens the profile you chose last.
